plans.name: Starter

plans.name: Growth

plans.name: Business

sharedFeatures: Discovery, filters and listing currency conversion
Company profiles and business verification after approval
Messaging, attachments and responding to enquiries
Deal progress, private documents and PDF exports
Eligible transaction reviews and company responses
One account across web, iOS and Android, with account security and notification preferences
notes: Prices are in CAD and exclude applicable taxes. Annual subscriptions cost ten monthly payments, equivalent to two months free.
User allowances include the owner. User, non-archived listing and new-enquiry allowances apply per company; saved searches apply per user.

New enquiries include direct enquiries and public RFQs. Receiving or replying to enquiries, quoting, and continuing existing conversations do not consume the proposed new-enquiry allowance. Normal safety and usage controls still apply.
Business verification and transaction reviews are earned through their respective approval and completed-deal processes. A paid plan cannot purchase either badge.
trial: Proposed trial: 30 days of Growth without a card, then Starter unless the company explicitly upgrades. This trial is not active yet.
downgrade: Proposed downgrade policy: retain business records and conversations; restrict new activity above the lower plan allowance.
supportNote: Priority support needs a staffed queue and stated business hours before it is offered. No guaranteed response time or 24/7 support is included.
